definitions.flagged: A target of kind 'false_positive' whose Refute verdict is REFUTED.
definitions.pass: The claim passes only if all three criteria hold on a complete run of every calibration target (the development target is excluded). A target whose analysis fails with an error counts as not recovered and not flagged.
definitions.recovered: A target of kind 'planet' in targets.yaml whose period found by Refute satisfies |P_found - P_published| / P_published <= 0.001, with P_published the NASA Exoplanet Archive value recorded in targets.yaml. Aliases (2P, P/2, 3P, P/3) are reported but do not count as recovered.
definitions.refuted_planet: A target of kind 'planet' whose Refute verdict is REFUTED.
definitions.scope: Easy regime only, as selected by calibration/PROTOCOL.md: periods 0.5 to 10 days, depths of at least 1000 ppm, TESS magnitude 12 or brighter, single-planet systems, SPOC 2-minute data in at least two calendar years. Nothing is claimed outside it.

canonical.hypothesis: Refute recovers at least 9 of 10 known TESS planets (period within 0.1% of the published value), flags at least 2 of 3 known false positives, and gives the verdict REFUTED to at most 1 of the 10 known planets.
canonical.title: Refute v0.1 calibration on known TESS planets and false positives
